programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha Beag Chlangair den bheachd gun do thuit an iomhas fanais às an fhànais ach chan eil e cinnteach dè th’ ann. Small Clanger thinks that some treasure fell from space, but he’s not at all sure what it is.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha na Losgannan a’ campachadh a-muigh le teant, geansaidhean agus marsmalothan. On a chilly day, the Froglets enjoy camping outside with a tent, sweaters and marshmallows.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Baba a' sealltainn g' eil e fàs a cheart cho comasach ri càch nuair a chuidicheas e faoileag bheag a chaidh a glacadh am measg sreang iasgach air an tràigh. Baba helps rescue a baby seagull caught up in fishing twine on the beach, proving that he is now as capable as his older sister and friends.

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha fleadh gu bhith aig sgioba nan luch 's tha Mossy trang a cruinneachadh dhearcagan air a shon. Ged a tha Oona 's Baba ga chuideachadh, tha cùisean a' dol bun os cionn orra, gun aca ach aon dhearcag aig deireadh an là! Mossy is busy collecting berries for the feast the shrew crew are planning. Oona and Baba decide to help their friend, but disaster strikes and they are left with nothing but a single berry at the end of the day.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein toilichte prìomh phàirt dealbh-chluich na sgoile fhaighinn, gus an cluinn e gur e “Bana-phrionnsa Bhàlaigh” an dealbh-chluich aca. Chan eil e airson a bhith na bhana-phrionnsa, oir ’s e nighean a tha sin! Petit is happy to be the star of the school play, until he discovers that the play they must act is 'The Brave Princess'. He doesn't want to be a princess, he's not a girl!

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: 'S e là spòrsail eile a th'ann an-diugh airson na h-Abadas agus tha iad glè thoilichte nuair a tha Ben airson cluich còmhla riutha leis a' gheama fhaclan. Dè'm facal a bhios ann agus cò a thèid air turas an-diugh: Hari an t-Each-uisge, Ela an Sionnach, neo Seren an t-Ialtag? It's another play-filled day today for the Abadas and they're delighted when Ben wants to join in and play the word game. What will the word be and who will get to go on today's adventure: Hari the Hippo, Ela the Fox or Seren the Bat?

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachd do chlann òga. Tha Joy Dunlop a’ leughadh An Sligeanach as Luaithe sa Bhaile. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh le Howard Calvert, a dhealbhachadh le Karen Obuhanych agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Joy Dunlop reads An Sligeanach as Luaithe sa Bhaile by Howard Calvert, illustrated by Karen Obuhanych and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Chan eil Stella toilichte oir tha aice ri dhol gu taigh granaidh aig an deireadh-sheachdain ‘s chan eil i den bheachd gum bi sin ro shaorsnail. Cuideachd, tha planaichean aice le Mia is Freya. Dè nì i? Stella isn’t happy as she has to go to grandma’s house at the weekend and she doesn’t think that will be very relaxing. Also, she has plans with Mia and Freya. What will she do?

programme.title: An Teaghlach Rìoghail an Ath-dhoras/The Royals Next Door
programme.desc: Tha èiginn eadar trì ginealaich an-diugh air Là nam Màthraichean ach tha e fortanach gu bheil Stella faisg air làimh airson gnothaichean a rèiteachadh. There’s distress between three generations today on Mother’s Day, but it’s fortunate that Stella is close by to reconcile matters.

programme.title: Clann Na Cruinne
programme.desc: ‘S toil le Carlota bhith rèiseadh mhotor-baidhseagalan. Bidh daoine ag ràdh g’ eil i luath ‘s mar sin bidh iAd a' toirt Cheetah oirre. Agus an uair a chur i dath na falt ‘s e an Cheetah Gorm a thug iad oirre. Carlota loves to race motorbikes fast which earned her the nickname Cheetah. So when she coloured her hair, they renamed her the Blue Cheetah.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Chan eil Belle, Sebastian is Adele ‘son Là a’ Bhìobhair a chall, ach ciamar a gheibh iad air sin a dhèanamh gun fhiosta do dh'Elaina – gu h-àraidh seach gu bheil Sonaidh air an leantainn? Belle, Sebastian and Adele don’t want to miss Groundhog Day, but how can they do this without Elaina noticing, especially since Sonny has followed them?

programme.title: Seonaidh | Shaun the Sheep
programme.desc: Tha Seonaidh agus a charaidean a' faireachdainn fàileadh uabhasach, saoil dè nì iad leis an tuathanach? The farmer's personal hygiene leaves much to be desired.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Brunch le Abigail
programme.desc: Tha Abigail a’ toirt dà rud math còmhla ann an dòigh annasach, pàirt croissant is pàirt muffin airson Cruffin! Abigail presents us with an unusual hybrid, part croissant and part muffin, a cruffin! In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap based on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Slighe Naoimh Cuithbeirt/St Cuthbert's Way
programme.desc: Iagan MacNèill a’leantail Slighe Naoimh Chuithbeirt a Maolros gu St Boswells. Iagan MacNeil explores the St Cuthbert’s Way, from Melrose to St Boswells.

programme.title: Rathad Ramsay
programme.desc: Ramsay MacMahon walks along the beaches of Barra with Michael Buchanan. Tha Ramsay MacMahon a’ coiseachd air tràighean Bharraigh le Mìcheal Bochanan.

programme.title: Larach Leabhar Dheir (The Missing Monastery)
programme.desc: Tha Leabhar Dhèir ann an Alba agus tha àrc-eòlaichean a’ leantainn orra a’ sireadh Mhanachainn Dhèir. As the Book of Deer visits Scotland, the hunt continues for Deer Monastery.

programme.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach/Dynamic Planet
programme.desc: As the planet heats up, those fighting climate change show how science, nature and tradition can prepare us for the future.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Tide Lines a’ tilleadh chun na fèise mu dheireadh thall, le Fiona NicChoinnich is Niall Iain Dòmhnallach a’ cur fàilt’ air a’ chòmhlan gu Àrd-Ùrlar Hot House. A’ toirt Glasgow Love Story gu Gàidhealtachd na h-Alba, tha an còmhlan a’ toirt thugainn òrain ùra air leth agus feadhainn aosta air a bheil meas mòr, le sluagh ceòlmhor aig Belladrum 2025. Tide Lines make a much-anticipated return to the festival as Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald welcome the band to the Hot House Stage. Bringing their Glasgow Love Story to the Scottish Highlands, the group perform exciting new tracks and beloved hits with their fans in full voice.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As Adam Frost’s brand new garden starts to take shape, it’s time to get some shrubs in the ground and construct a path. He also makes a start on planting up a potted herb garden and shares some ideas on what to grow against a wall, whether it be sunny or shady. At home in Devon, Carol Klein is mixing it up with flowers and edibles, where sweet peas and cosmos happily mingle with beetroot, basil and beans. And at West Dean Gardens in Chichester, Jamie Butterworth reveals the secrets of growing that border belle, the delphinium. In Birmingham, a lover of roses has created a garden full to brimming with beautiful blooms, while a gardener in Norwich shares her contemporary cottage garden that became a refuge when she needed it most.

programme.title: BBC Four Sessions
programme.desc: In a programme first broadcast in 2005, Loudon Wainwright III plays tracks from his album Here Come the Choppers alongside such classics as One Man Guy and Hard Day on the Planet to an enthusiastic audience. Footage shot during his British tour that year is at once hilarious and moving, revealing a complex and talented character who has spent decades turning everyday personal matters into public art.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Can you get the measure of Christina Trevanion's mystery object? It has a metal base that supports a measuring stick, with a moveable plastic pump attached. Will the fairgoers in Exeter guess what it is? While they puzzle its purpose, antiques experts Gary Pe and Ben Cooper hunt for bargains with dad and daughter David and Ellie and partners Darren and Simon. Darren immediately spots a stall of shiny costume jewellery. Gary thinks its inspiration comes from the Middle East but doubts any of it is profitable. On the other team, Ellie takes a fancy to a pair of etched, cut-glass decanters, but as Ben explains, they don’t make the sort of money they used to, so they stroll on. One of our pairs is also tempted by a massive nut with an exotic name – until they see the price tag! After the fair, Christina and the teams head to Wiltshire to see whether their items will bring in the cash at auction. Tim Weeks is on the rostrum, but who is going home with the most money?

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Can you get the measure of Christina Trevanion's mystery object? It has a metal base that supports a measuring stick, with a moveable plastic pump attached. Will the fairgoers in Exeter guess what it is? While they puzzle its purpose, antiques experts Gary Pe and Ben Cooper hunt for bargains with dad and daughter David and Ellie and partners Darren and Simon. programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Can you get the measure of Christina Trevanion's mystery object? It has a metal base that supports a measuring stick, with a moveable plastic pump attached. Will the fairgoers in Exeter guess what it is? While they puzzle its purpose, antiques experts Gary Pe and Ben Cooper hunt for bargains with dad and daughter David and Ellie and partners Darren and Simon. Darren immediately spots a stall of shiny costume jewellery. Gary thinks its inspiration comes from the Middle East but doubts any of it is profitable. On the other team, Ellie takes a fancy to a pair of etched, cut-glass decanters, but as Ben explains, they don’t make the sort of money they used to, so they stroll on. One of our pairs is also tempted by a massive nut with an exotic name – until they see the price tag! After the fair, Christina and the teams head to Wiltshire to see whether their items will bring in the cash at auction. Tim Weeks is on the rostrum, but who is going home with the most money?

programme.title: Reporting Scotland
programme.desc: More from the day’s top stories and communities across Scotland.

programme.title: Scotland's Greatest Escape
programme.desc: JJ Chalmers and Grado uncover the best holiday escapes in Scotland. But it’s up to friends and families from all over the country to decide which escapes make it to the grand final. In this first episode, lifelong Glaswegian friends the Karens are tasked with choosing Scotland’s Greatest Luxury Escape. They visit a secluded retreat, The Hideaway near Dundee; enjoy a private cruise aboard Argyll Cruising on the wonderful west coast; and finally visit Glenapp Castle on the Ayrshire coast. But only one escape will make it to the grand final.

programme.title: Paramedics on Scene
programme.desc: A patient in Glasgow becomes violent, forcing crewmates Gregg and Bernadette to shelter in an ambulance. Unfortunately, this shocking incident is one that is becoming an everyday reality for paramedics across Scotland, with nearly 200 on-duty staff physically assaulted each year. In Dundee, paramedic Rebecca and technician Paige treat a patient who has suffered a potentially lethal drug overdose after taking a potent mix of MDMA and heroin. Rebecca and Paige must administer urgent treatment to save the patient’s life. Meanwhile, at the ambulance control centre, call handler Jackie takes 999 calls from two road traffic collisions - one in which a motorcyclist suffers a seizure, and another where concerns are raised about a baby. In both cases, Jackie has to keep calm under extraordinary pressure, organising an ambulance response while delivering important instructions to keep the patients safe. And in Aberdeen, the Special Operations Response Team is sent to help Allison, who has fallen at home and is now displaying the symptoms of a possible stroke. They also attend an expansive wildfire that has required a mass deployment of emergency service personnel.

programme.title: Selling Scotland
programme.desc: Jack Docherty takes an entertaining look at Scotland's most memorable adverts. Joining him on this archive journey will be some of Scotland's funniest and best known faces.

programme.title: Still Game
programme.desc: Sitcom featuring characters from comedy series Chewin' the Fat. Jack and Victor, jealous of Old Tam's success at winning prizes by entering catchphrase competitions, decide to come up with a catchy new slogan for scones.

programme.title: Two Doors Down
programme.desc: Beth is ill and has taken to her bed. Ian and Gordon have popped over to give Eric a hand. If ever there’s a time Beth is desperate to be left alone, it’s now - but on hearing about Beth’s flu, Christine turns up with homemade soup. The interruptions continue as Cathy and Colin arrive, who suggest all Beth needs is someone with a bit of personality to go and see her. Up and down the stairs like a yo-yo, Eric tends to Beth’s needs, reassuring her that nobody will disturb her. But the neighbours have decided Eric isn’t coping, and it’s a competition to see whether a hot toddy or soup made from a good ham bone will do the trick in nursing Beth back to health.

programme.title: TRNSMT
programme.desc: Shereen Cutkelvin presents highlights from TRNSMT 2026 weekend, including performances from CMAT, Sonny Fodera, Caity Baser, Cammy Barnes, Rianne Downey, The Last Dinner Party, Skye Newman and headliners Kasabian.

programme.title: This is BBC Scotland
programme.desc: Highlights from the BBC Scotland channel.

programme.title: Blackmailed: The Sextortion Killers
programme.desc: Reporter Tir Dhondy investigates the rise of sextortion scams targeting teenage boys on social media, including the case of 16-year-old victim Evan Boettler. Her journey leads to Nigeria, where she confronts the scammers taking part in these crimes. With unprecedented access and interviews with industry insiders, Dhondy exposes a disturbing online underworld and its devastating consequences.

programme.title: Fake Friend: The Ticket Scammer
programme.desc: How a Somerset high-flyer turned his charm and connections into tools of deception – conning his school friends and hundreds of others while living a life of glamour himself.

programme.title: Dance Passion
programme.desc: The UK’s dance artists, from classical ballet dancers and Strictly Come Dancing stars to choreographed skydivers and car-eographed drivers, race across the country to meet Lady G in Corey Baker’s thrilling new film. It rallies dancers, drones, precision drivers and a closed track - buckle up for dance like you’ve never seen it before. Corey Baker is known for his films featuring dance in striking and unexpected locations, including the award-winning Swan Lake Bath Ballet for BBC Arts, filmed in the bathtubs of elite ballet dancers around the world during lockdown. Part of Dance Passion, a celebration of dance from across the UK.

programme.title: Roald Dahl's Matilda the Musical
programme.desc: Musical based on Roald Dahl's classic book. Matilda Wormwood is a little girl with a sharp mind, a vivid imagination and the worst parents in the world. On meeting her inspirational teacher Miss Honey, Matilda begins conjuring her own fantastical tales.

programme.title: Ludwig
programme.desc: After a breakthrough finding a coded notebook, John decides to return to the police station to gather more information about his missing brother’s last case. Before John can make much progress, his thirst for all things cryptic sees him drawn to another grisly crime scene at a grand manor house. What looks like a missing person’s case turns into something far more sinister as John puts his puzzle mind to work. Back at home, a frustrated Lucy takes matters into her own hands and embarks on a fact-finding mission to the home of one of her husband’s ex-colleagues.

programme.title: Amandaland
programme.desc: After finding out Mal is banging the gym teacher, Amanda is spurred into action on the dating front herself. She accepts a date from Johannes – a property developer from South Africa who now lives in a penthouse in Wapping. He’s seen her ‘Senuous’ social media page and is keen to meet for a drink. Meanwhile, things are getting serious between Amanda’s daughter Georgie and Anne’s son Darius, much to Anne’s delight. Felicity seems to have taken a lover of her own, disappearing off for ‘lunches’ and buying luxury pyjamas, and Mal is worried that his new girlfriend might be a little too young for him.

programme.title: Amandaland
programme.desc: Amanda finds herself out of her comfort zone when Anne organises a camping trip. Amanda’s new boyfriend Johannes is a keen camper, so she’s forced to dig out her Hunter wellies and tag along – on the proviso that she can hire a camper van. What should be a wholesome weekend away ends up being a nightmare. Amanda realises that the VW Westphalia she's hired doesn’t have a toilet. So it’s either the communal drop loos, or she crosses her legs for the entire weekend. Meanwhile, Johannes rubs Mal up the wrong way, Anne gets hormonal, Fi embraces life under canvas, and Della has to deal with a disaster back at the restaurant.

programme.title: Amandaland
programme.desc: It’s the end-of-season awards do at Hounslow Eagles' clubhouse, and Amanda throws herself into the organisation of the prize-giving party. So, it's out with the buckets of Haribo and a keg of beer, and in with the black tie, churros and cocktails. Meanwhile, not only has her new boyfriend Johannes bought her a brand new Range Rover, he also makes her a generous offer – to move into his massive Wapping penthouse. Amanda is presented with a difficult choice. Does she return to her life of high ceilings and 4x4s, or does she fully commit to her SoHa family? While all this is going down, Georgie and Morten cement their friendship, Mal and Ned take over the decks, and Della has some big news to break to Fi.

programme.title: Amandaland
programme.desc: Amanda and the family head to Aunt Joan’s country house, but the plans change when Mal and Anne tag along, and she struggles to recreate the magical Christmases she spent there as a child. Anne is in despair at being separated from her family, and Felicity is increasingly irritated by her sister’s constant high spirits. Meanwhile, Mal sees a hidden photo that seems to reveal a deep family secret.

programme.title: Smoggie Queens
programme.desc: It’s games night, and Dickie has concocted 'an absolutely amazing' murder mystery evening full of twists and turns. Solving the murder should be easy, if he can keep it all on track.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Punk Chef welcomes two guests, illustrator, interior designer and teacher Emma Iliffe, and architect and founder of the Deaf Architecture Front Chris Laing, for two separate, intimate cafe conversations over their chosen drinks.

programme.title: Two Weeks in August
programme.desc: Zoe is looking to a future with Solomon, but her awakening seems to have deadly consequences, as a wildfire threatens the island. Not everyone will make it home, and none of them can go back to who they were. Jacob can’t outrun his problems, and Nat must choose her future. Losing Zoe drives Dan to take dangerous risks and forces them both to confront the truth about who they are and what they want. Zoe has a painful decision to make before she can step into a new life.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: After the dramatic developments in Westminster, and with Andy Burnham now poised to enter Downing Street, Question Time returns for a special programme presented by Fiona Bruce. On the panel, Labour chair of the Foreign Affairs Select Committee Emily Thornberry; Conservative Party chairman Kevin Hollinrake; Reform UK's home affairs spokesperson Zia Yusuf and economist and journalist Stephanie Flanders.

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: The A to Z of TV Gardening
programme.desc: Carol Kirkwood takes an alphabetical journey through the world of gardening, getting inspiration and advice from some of the BBC's most popular garden presenters and programmes. In this episode, she is exploring subjects that all begin with the letter M. Marvel at the oddity that is the monkey puzzle tree. Alys Fowler is mesmerised by magnolias and a marigold enthusiast.

programme.title: The Travelling Auctioneers
programme.desc: Bee and Lauren hunt for treasure at a retired butcher’s home in Leeds. Sniffing out a collection of Troika pottery, they help twice-widowed Michael relive a special family holiday.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock returns to Hampshire to see one of the gardens she designed with the Rich Brothers. programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome little ones Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, River, Araiya and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag are numbered building blocks, and all the parents and little ones have different objects and toys that are themed around numbers. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate number-themed objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The traditional children’s nursery rhyme One, Two, Buckle My Shoe features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring numbers too. The Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Vegesaurs

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: The Squirrels go for a woodland walk to help Duggee look for a very special leaf when they hear the strangest noise. In the distance, they can see a funny shape. What is that noise? What is that shape? Maybe it's a monster? No, wait! It's only Hedgley the hedgehog, who has been trundling around the forest collecting all sorts of leaves and twigs on his spiky quills, which make him look and sound like a leafy monster.

Chantelle meets Ezzie to find out how caterpillars grow and change into cocoons and chrysalis. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy are in the garden looking on leaves and bushes for caterpillars. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain how big caterpillars get, whether they make a noise and how they move. It’s also time to find out how caterpillars help the eco-system as providers. Sandy’s friend Zoe joins for this episode’s Teeny Tiny Task; making a caterpillar cafe.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the beach, and Ted tries his hand at making a sandcastle. When it doesn’t go quite to plan, Dad shows him some top tips. After some fun flying a kite, the family enjoy a game of catch. And what trip to the beach is complete without an ice cream?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Valentina is making a Greek vegetarian moussaka for her friends because her family is from Greece. Her delicious recipe is loaded with fresh vegetables such as courgettes and aubergines and topped with green lentils packed with goodness. She finishes it off by making a yoghurt topping and covering everything with grated cheese. Some of Valentina's friends don't like the taste of cooked aubergine on its own. As aubergine is one of the main ingredients in vegetarian moussaka, let's see if Valentina can change their minds when she serves the cooked meal to them.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: She goes on a training rescue mission with a lifeboat team to find out how the equipment on a lifeboat works. She shows us how the special thermal-imaging cameras are used to find people who are in trouble - even at night! Next, she visits a quarry to see how gravel, sand, cement and water are mixed together to make concrete. Maddie uses her special cameras to follow the journey the ingredients take from the quarry to the plant where everything is mixed together. We see how the mixing lorry then takes the concrete to the building site and how it is poured to make a road!

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Meagaidh the border collie is a search and rescue dog who works with her owner, Tom. Her supernose follows scents and smells like clues so she can rescue people who need her help. Annie is in a kayak, but she doesn't have her map and is totally lost. She’s managed to paddle to a beach, but she’s cold and wet, and has hurt her wrist. At the Woofton Search and Rescue Centre, Tom and Meagaidh need to find Annie, and fast! At the beach, Meagaidh has to navigate the tricky terrain to help Tom find Annie and get her to safety. But first, she must filter out all the other smells – the sea, the sand, even a talking bin – so she can find Annie’s scent. Want to come along on Meagaidh’s Dog Squad mission? Then let’s get mission ready!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar drive through the baboons’ enclosure in a special bus. The mischievous baboons have fun climbing all over the bus and show off their acrobatic skills. It’s then feeding time for the giant river otters, who show Steve and Aneeshwar their super swimming skills. They then find out the wild connection between these two very different animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock

programme.title: Yukee

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s Maddie’s first day at chess club, and she’s a little lonely because Mum can’t come with her. But she soon meets a cool new friend, who helps her settle in. Before long, that desert island feeling turns into a tropical paradise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is distracted from his newspaper because he must warn Roly not to spill his drink and tell Norrie not to drop crumbs; the Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess, so Duggee teaches them an important lesson. The Squirrels learn that there are certain dos and don’ts that you must follow in order to avoid mess or getting hurt, but that you can still have fun along the way. Knowing why they should listen to these rules helps them understand their importance - if you spill your drink, someone could slip, and leftover crumbs can attract unwelcome guests. The Squirrels take turns suggesting their dos and don’ts, but some are a bit more niche than others. But most importantly, they remember that you do have fun with your friends!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten riders, ten pedal-powered cars, but only one can lift the trophy. Welcome to the Numberblock Rally! Learn about taking away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: L discovers that bath time is more fun when you double up. Then H and I hop in, and soon the tub is slip-sliding down a giant hill, picking up Alphablocks as it goes - even more fun! This episode introduces the double letters LL, SS and FF and the words tub, hill, doll, bell, mess, miss, kiss and off.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble wants a bedtime story - but not before he gets ready for bed. Meanwhile, Justin has a magical bedtime adventure with his friends.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky keeps standing in the way of Laa-Laa's view of the flowers, but Laa-Laa likes looking at Tinky Winky just as much as the flowers. The Teletubbies watch a Tummy Tale where children play hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 145 million years to the time of allosaurus - a massive meat-eating dinosaur that roamed the salt flats of North America. Hatty's display features a fossilised footprint of an allosaurus that she found on her travels, but when the delivery of salt she needed to finish the display fails to turn up (in fact it turns out to be pepper), Andy vows to fix the problem. His mission is to travel back to the prehistoric salt flats and collect enough salt to finish the display. Along the way he befriends an allosaurus, but two others turn up which are less friendly and the adventure culminates in a breathtaking chase along the salt flats as the allosauruses dodge the giant legs and long necks of a herd of diplodocuses.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s Stall. She chooses the small ‘Grasshopper Pie’ sign and remembers the day she got it. Mrs Juniper’s new dessert ‘Grasshopper Pie’ is creating quite a stir in the Big Hub. Moira has never heard of it, and after a series of misunderstandings, begins to worry that there are real grasshoppers in it! Suki is helping Daisy at the vets when there is an emergency with Mrs Anderson’s dog, Bonnie. Suki reassures and comforts the worried Mrs Anderson. Back at the Hub, a revolted Moira has decided to enforce a new rule: ‘No Grasshopper Pie in the Big Hub!’ After scaring away Mrs Juniper’s customers, Mack and Bob reassure Moira that there are no real grasshoppers in the pie, and she realises her mistake. Bonnie’s operation goes well and they discover the problem – a swallowed piece of old slipper. Daisy praises Suki for supporting Mrs Anderson, telling her that she’ll make a great vet one day. Back at the Hub, Moira has some making up to do. Soon the customers return, and Mrs Juniper sees the funny side of Moira’s misunderstanding.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, explores three machines powered by electricity! Grace goes for a ride in an autonomous shuttle, shows off an electric coach and, finally, gets to work cutting a lawn on an electric sit-on mower.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are hungry, but they’re not sure what to eat to fill their tummies, so they turn to Duggee for help. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels, and together they pick out something they’d like. They decide the nut roast takes too long to make, and although cheetah toast is quicker, they don’t like getting raisins stuck in their teeth. Once they’ve picked a recipe, Duggee teaches them how to complete it: get the ingredients, prepare them and then put it together. After making some fun mess in the kitchen and a great cooking lesson, the Squirrels get to complete the last step together and eat what they made. Delicious!

BaBa is very grateful.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Go Jetters

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter embarks on a series of exciting adventures and tries to be just like his late father, with the help of his best friends Benjamin and Lily. Peter and his friends set out to taste the sweetest dandelions in the world, only to find that they're protected by the meanest character in the entire valley!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Shellington and the Octonauts try to track an unusual creature, a jellyfish that can transform from old to young repeatedly and live forever.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblobs challenge Twenty to a singing count-off. Who can count to 20 in the most original ways? Learn how to count up and down and in steps with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. When the Alphablocks can't decide between rock and pop, it's time for a battle of the bands to see which is best.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris take refuge in grumpy Millie the Squid’s cave during a storm but accidentally damage a painting. Can they find a clever way to fix it before Millie finds out?

programme.title: Playtime Towers
programme.desc: Bella and Lift make a new friend with an awesome roar, Steggy the Dinosaur! Together, they visit Tincy in the Sing Song Forest for a dinosaur song.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing wants to draw a big picture, so Flop finds him some chalk to draw on the pavement. Bing draws a fabulous stripy, spotty, zig-zag dinosaur, but just as he has finished, a rain shower washes the dinosaur away. Bing is devastated until he sees that a bit of dinosaur is left behind, and with that new beginning there is another chalk something waiting to be created.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘raspberry’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure! Today is all about raspberries - we see a red raspberry, a small one, a fancy hat raspberry and a high raspberry. Dee and a friend cuddle a soft raspberry and we meet the one and only Princess Raspberry! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu fails to realise that Biba is scared by a game that they are playing together.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou gather Yum Yum Baronies on Nonsense Day.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: The Froglets find a magnifying glass and become detectives to hunt for a missing crayon.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos watch a man as he covers his car in cleaning foam. The foam runs out and the cleaning machine breaks so the man goes off to get some tools to repair the machine. Meanwhile, Great BigHoo and Toodloo investigate the spray nozzle. Toodloo manages to get it to work but when Chickedy and Chick have a go, the spray nozzle squirts foam everywhere. The man peeps out from the garage to find the house, garden and car all covered in foam! The Twirlywoos are visited by the Box, which brings a snow cloud. The snow cloud covers everything inside The Big Red Boat in snow. The Hooter helps to clear up.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin goes shoe shopping. Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble at The Shop with the Lot for pair of new red boots!

programme.title: My Petsaurus
programme.desc: Preschool series. On a walk through the park, Chloe, Mum and Topsy meet some new friends - Lewis and his pet stegosaurus Peggy.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po receive a call on the Tubby Phone. It's the Tiddlytubbies, ringing to say hello just before the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome little ones Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, River, Araiya and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Parents, carers and their babies at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! Inside Giovanna’s bag are numbered building blocks, and all the parents and little ones have different objects and toys that are themed around numbers. These are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby-appropriate number-themed objects and toys inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The traditional children’s nursery rhyme One, Two, Buckle My Shoe features, as does a story involving Baby Bear, and viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring numbers too. The Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with sensory bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children craft paper plate sheep with cotton wool, learn British Sign Language signs for little, lamb and snow, then sing and sign Mary Had a Little Lamb.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron is joined by Jackson and Mia as they discover how to feed the garden, and the special role wiggly worms have in making sure the plants stay happy and healthy.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the baby elephant is fed up with being small. Hamza finds some wonderful wildebeest in the wild. Later, he uses a brush to help the baby rhinos relax.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Dragonfruitflyus mimics Vegesaur sounds, which sparks a competition among Pea-Rex babies.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo run a crazy hotel, with Dad as their put-upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them the importance of compromise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels go for a woodland walk to help Duggee look for a very special leaf when they hear the strangest noise. In the distance, they can see a funny shape. What is that noise? What is that shape? Maybe it's a monster? No, wait! It's only Hedgley the hedgehog, who has been trundling around the forest collecting all sorts of leaves and twigs on his spiky quills, which make him look and sound like a leafy monster.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Green stages a magic show to introduce her new friends Black and White. Learn the difference between light, bright and dark colours with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Benjamin and his brothers want to find out about teeny tiny creatures that crawl – caterpillars. Chantelle meets Ezzie to find out how caterpillars grow and change into cocoons and chrysalis. Meanwhile, Rory and his son Sandy are in the garden looking on leaves and bushes for caterpillars. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files explain how big caterpillars get, whether they make a noise and how they move. It’s also time to find out how caterpillars help the eco-system as providers. Sandy’s friend Zoe joins for this episode’s Teeny Tiny Task; making a caterpillar cafe.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the beach, and Ted tries his hand at making a sandcastle. When it doesn’t go quite to plan, Dad shows him some top tips. After some fun flying a kite, the family enjoy a game of catch. And what trip to the beach is complete without an ice cream?

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Valentina is making a Greek vegetarian moussaka for her friends because her family is from Greece. Her delicious recipe is loaded with fresh vegetables such as courgettes and aubergines and topped with green lentils packed with goodness. She finishes it off by making a yoghurt topping and covering everything with grated cheese. Some of Valentina's friends don't like the taste of cooked aubergine on its own. As aubergine is one of the main ingredients in vegetarian moussaka, let's see if Valentina can change their minds when she serves the cooked meal to them.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: She goes on a training rescue mission with a lifeboat team to find out how the equipment on a lifeboat works. She shows us how the special thermal-imaging cameras are used to find people who are in trouble - even at night! Next, she visits a quarry to see how gravel, sand, cement and water are mixed together to make concrete. Maddie uses her special cameras to follow the journey the ingredients take from the quarry to the plant where everything is mixed together. We see how the mixing lorry then takes the concrete to the building site and how it is poured to make a road!

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Meagaidh the border collie is a search and rescue dog who works with her owner, Tom. Her supernose follows scents and smells like clues so she can rescue people who need her help. Annie is in a kayak, but she doesn't have her map and is totally lost. She’s managed to paddle to a beach, but she’s cold and wet, and has hurt her wrist. At the Woofton Search and Rescue Centre, Tom and Meagaidh need to find Annie, and fast! At the beach, Meagaidh has to navigate the tricky terrain to help Tom find Annie and get her to safety. But first, she must filter out all the other smells – the sea, the sand, even a talking bin – so she can find Annie’s scent. Want to come along on Meagaidh’s Dog Squad mission? Then let’s get mission ready!

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Steve and Aneeshwar drive through the baboons’ enclosure in a special bus. The mischievous baboons have fun climbing all over the bus and show off their acrobatic skills. It’s then feeding time for the giant river otters, who show Steve and Aneeshwar their super swimming skills. They then find out the wild connection between these two very different animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona is nervous about her first dawn chorus and practises singing with Mama.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: It's the day the geese fly over on their annual migration south. When Sonny reports that geese put on an amazing display if you mimic their calls, the gang look for the right sound to get a response from the geese before they fly past!

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: It’s Maddie’s first day at chess club, and she’s a little lonely because Mum can’t come with her. But she soon meets a cool new friend, who helps her settle in. Before long, that desert island feeling turns into a tropical paradise.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is distracted from his newspaper because he must warn Roly not to spill his drink and tell Norrie not to drop crumbs; the Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess, so Duggee teaches them an important lesson. The Squirrels learn that there are certain dos and don’ts that you must follow in order to avoid mess or getting hurt, but that you can still have fun along the way. Knowing why they should listen to these rules helps them understand their importance - if you spill your drink, someone could slip, and leftover crumbs can attract unwelcome guests. The Squirrels take turns suggesting their dos and don’ts, but some are a bit more niche than others. But most importantly, they remember that you do have fun with your friends!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Ten riders, ten pedal-powered cars, but only one can lift the trophy. Welcome to the Numberblock Rally! Learn about taking away with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: L discovers that bath time is more fun when you double up. Then H and I hop in, and soon the tub is slip-sliding down a giant hill, picking up Alphablocks as it goes - even more fun! This episode introduces the double letters LL, SS and FF and the words tub, hill, doll, bell, mess, miss, kiss and off.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble wants a bedtime story - but not before he gets ready for bed. Meanwhile, Justin has a magical bedtime adventure with his friends.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky keeps standing in the way of Laa-Laa's view of the flowers, but Laa-Laa likes looking at Tinky Winky just as much as the flowers. The Teletubbies watch a Tummy Tale where children play hide-and-seek.

programme.title: Andy's Dinosaur Adventures
programme.desc: Andy travels back 145 million years to the time of allosaurus - a massive meat-eating dinosaur that roamed the salt flats of North America. Hatty's display features a fossilised footprint of an allosaurus that she found on her travels, but when the delivery of salt she needed to finish the display fails to turn up (in fact it turns out to be pepper), Andy vows to fix the problem. His mission is to travel back to the prehistoric salt flats and collect enough salt to finish the display. Along the way he befriends an allosaurus, but two others turn up which are less friendly and the adventure culminates in a breathtaking chase along the salt flats as the allosauruses dodge the giant legs and long necks of a herd of diplodocuses.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: The Human Time Bomb. 1971. Stars Jean Trend, Roddy McMillan & Patrick Godfrey. Dr Fay Chantry performs a biological study of tower block life - and finds far more than she expected. [S]

programme.title: Shadows on the Stairs
programme.desc: 1941. Crime. Director: D. Ross Lederman. Stars Frieda Inescort & Paul Cavanagh. Occupants of a boarding house become suspects after a string of murders. [S]

programme.title: A Day Begins in Manchester (1960s)
programme.desc: Warming Glimpses of Manchester 'waking up'. From the streets to the factories and the docks and everything in between.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1964. Who Killed Who IV? Directed by Don Weis. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Burke's old flame is a suspect for the murder of Socialite equestrian William Henry Otis IV.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: 1965. Fringe Benefits. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: I Lived With You
programme.desc: 1933. Drama. Stars: Ursula Jeans, Ida Lupino & Minnie Rayner. A penniless Russian Prince is befriended by Gladys who takes him home to live with her folks. Co-written by Ivor Novello. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Take a step back in time and enjoy the hit 60s tune Runaround Sue by Dion.

programme.title: You Pay Your Money
programme.desc: 1957. Crime Drama. A rogue smuggler enters a murky world when his wife is kidnapped. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Hugh McDermott, Jane Hylton and Honor Blackman. [S]

programme.title: Hindle Wakes
programme.desc: 1952. Drama starring Leslie Dwyer and Lisa Daniely. Successful remake of one of the earliest British talkies. Set in the Hindle, two mill workers take off to Blackpool for the 'Wakes' holiday. [S]

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Lucy and the Ring-a-Ding-Ring. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Mary Jane Croft. Mr Mooney has an expensive ring made for his wife but it looks like he won't be able to gift it to her... [S]

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Harry Keller. Stars Don Taylor, Randy Stuart & Paul Dubov. A man begins to question the death of his first wife shortly after he gets remarried. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Unsung Heroes. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Marjie Lawrence & Deborah Watling. Ash tackles a bomb, it's not considered vital, but the new fuse extractor doesn't work.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: The Rivals. 1963. Directed by Max Varnel. Stars Jack Gwillim, Erica Rogers & Brian Smith. Millionaire Swedish industrialist Rolf Neilson is horrified when his daughter is kidnapped. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Brothers. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Alexander Guage. A poor young serf is helped into a monastery by Robin and Friar Tuck but flees when he discovers his brother is in prison. [S]

programme.title: Two Way Stretch
programme.desc: 1960. Comedy. Directed by Robert Day. Stars Peter Sellers, David Lodge & Bernard Cribbins. Dodger Lane intends to break out of prison, steal a fortune in diamonds, and break back into prison. [S]

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: The Mighty Warrior. 1962. Stars John Ireland & John Scott. A champion steeplechase horse falls and dies during a race, costing Eastern Insurance £20,000. Hunter is sent to investigate the stables. [S]

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: The Night They Hit No.8. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas, Shelagh Fraser & Julie Goodyear. During a night of intense bombing the Ashton children are nowhere to be found. [S]

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: Double Jeopardy. 1989. Stars Robert Powell, Cathryn Harrison & Nigel Le Vaillant. When Hannay is entrusted with a dozen diamonds, he little knows the danger and distress they will bring. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Profit by their Example. 1964. Stars Kate Allitt, Jessica Dunning & James Ellis. Watt investigates as a youngster is hospitalised, but soon finds out that events are spiralling out of control. [S]

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1971. The Man Who Didn't Eat Sweets. Stars Alfred Burke, Brenda Cavendish & Colin Baker. Marker is hired after a lady finds a picture of a young woman in her husbands wallet. [S]

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: 1987. Thriller. Director: Peter Yates. Stars Cher, Dennis Quaid & Liam Neeson. A homeless man is accused of murder and a public defender is tasked with mounting his legal defence. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro is here to open the Cellar Club and introduce the new series starting tonight at the Cellar Club: Supernatural... [S]

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: Ghost of Venice. 1977. Stars Robert Hardy, Sinead Cusack & Isabel Dean. A British man befriends a mysterious woman whose presence seems other worldly. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Up next Caroline Introduces the film: Nosferatu The Vampyre, the 1979 horror directed by Werner Herzog. [S]

programme.title: Nosferatu The Vampyre
programme.desc: 1979. Horror. Director: Werner Herzog. Stars: Klaus Kinski, Isabelle Adjani, Bruno Ganz. Count Dracula moves from Transylvania to Wismar, spreading the Black Plague across the land. [S]
